01
DAY 1 · SUN 22 NOV 2026 · PATTAYA

An easy arrival, a sea-view evening.

BKK straight to Pattaya · recover first · Beach Road after sunset

Morning · airport to the coast
Morning → 11:00

BKK → Pattaya, directly

After immigration and baggage, meet a prebooked private car at Suvarnabhumi. Do not go into Bangkok city. Drive about 1.5–2 hours in ordinary traffic; add margin for queues and congestion. Around 11:00 arrival is a target, not a guarantee. Fare THB TBD / AED TBD per vehicle, including tolls, waiting and luggage. BKK airport ↗

Maps ↗
11:30–13:00

Lunch near the hotel

Choose Kiss Food & Drinks on Second Road for casual Thai dishes, or the Central Pattaya mall food court for an easy indoor meal. Menus, hours and per-person cost THB TBD / AED TBD. Leave bags with the hotel if needed. Kiss Food ↗ · Central Pattaya ↗

Afternoon · shower, rest, recover
14:00–16:15

Check in and slow down

Central Pattaya / Beach Road is the base for two nights. Request an early room if available, but keep normal check-in around 14:00 subject to hotel policy. Shower, rest and recover from the overnight flight. No major ticketed attraction today.

16:30–18:00

Coffee with a view at Drift

Drift at Hilton Pattaya, Level 16, keeps the café stop on Beach Road. Coffee, dessert and a bay view without a cross-town drive. Published menu lists the Drift Stones dessert at THB 350 (AED ≈39), before any applicable service/tax; drinks and table policy TBD. Be seated before the approximately 17:46 sunset. Drift menu ↗

Maps ↗
Evening · walk, eat, unwind
18:00 onward

Beach Road → Walking Street

Walk south at your own pace, roughly 1.5 km from Central Pattaya to the Walking Street entrance. Explore briefly, then choose a convenient massage on the return route; treatment price/duration TBD before starting. No need to stay out late. Walking Street ↗

Maps ↗
Optional quick stop

The famous “fancy” 7-Eleven

Keep this optional: the exact viral branch has not been reliably matched. Ask the hotel to confirm its Maps pin; stop only if it is on the walking/short-car route. Do not add a special drive to an unverified branch or label a normal shop as the famous one. Find and confirm the branch ↗

Dinner → hotel

Easy Thai food or street food

Use Pattaya Night Bazaar / Second Road stalls if trading, or Kiss Food & Drinks for a sit-down meal. Menu, hours and cost THB TBD / AED TBD. Return to the hotel and sleep. Night Bazaar ↗

Central Pattaya · Vegetarian options available. Best fit: Day 1 or Day 2 dinner.

02
DAY 2 · MON 23 NOV 2026 · PATTAYA

Into the sky, then south along the coast.

Tandem skydive → Naklua → Sanctuary of Truth → sunset viewpoint

Morning · the main adventure
07:00–07:30

Hotel pickup for Thai Sky Adventures

Request the operator’s published 07:00 Pattaya pickup. The 07:00–07:30 window is planning only until your hotel is confirmed. Their FAQ includes return hotel transport; a direct Naklua drop-off is NOT automatically included. Arrange it explicitly or book a separate car from the drop zone.

Maps ↗
07:30–12:30 approx.

Tandem skydive · Si Racha / Nong Khor area

Allow the morning for briefing, weather and aircraft rotation. This is the skydiving slot, not a guaranteed completion time. Current official booking page: basic tandem THB 9,450 (AED 1,050) per jumper; video THB 13,250 (AED ≈1,472), video + photos THB 14,250 (AED ≈1,583), deluxe THB 15,250 (AED ≈1,694). The older PDF shows a lower price; use the live booking page and reconfirm. Packages ↗ · Pickup & requirements ↗

Afternoon · north to south
13:00–14:00

Lunch toward Naklua / North Pattaya

Travel directly toward Naklua after the jump; allow roughly 40–60 minutes from the drop-zone area, driver-confirmed. Choose Mum Aroi Naklua for seafood or a nearby Thai lunch. Cost/opening hours THB TBD / AED TBD. If the jump ends at 12:30, lunch may start closer to 13:30; avoid a Central Pattaya hotel detour.

Maps ↗
14:30–15:45

Sanctuary of Truth

Arrive for a confirmed guided admission slot; allow at least 75–90 minutes including check-in and the wooden architecture. Published adult day entry THB 500 (AED ≈56), daytime ticketing 08:00–17:00. If the tour needs until 16:00, keep it unhurried and drop the optional Big Buddha. Official ticket & slots ↗

Maps ↗
15:45–17:00

Continue south · Big Buddha only if comfortable

Allow 40–60 minutes through Pattaya toward Pratumnak. Wat Phra Yai / Big Buddha is optional around 16:15–16:45, with entry/hours TBD. Skip it if traffic or the guided visit runs long. The viewpoint sunset takes priority.

Maps ↗
17:00–18:00

Phra Tamnak / Pattaya Viewpoint

Aim to arrive by 17:00, well before sunset at approximately 17:46 on 23 November. Enjoy golden hour and the bay lights; do not plan an 18:00 arrival. If the skydive is heavily delayed, shorten lunch and omit optional stops; never rush the jump or compress the Sanctuary visit into a photo dash.

Maps ↗
Evening · a relaxed coast-side finish
18:15 onward

Cozy Beach / Pratumnak coast

Continue locally to Three Mermaids for a sea-view dinner, or The Sky Gallery for a relaxed coastal table. Booking, menu prices and hours TBD. This is an evening stop, not a Pattaya beach day. Return to Central Pattaya after dinner. Three Mermaids ↗ · Sky Gallery ↗

WHERE WE SLEEP

Checkout in Pattaya

The Quarter Hualamphong by UHG

Preferred room: Deluxe King Room with City View. Not booked; price and availability TBD. Leave luggage/check in if ready and freshen up. A quick meal at Hilly’s in the hotel or nearby Sukon 1 Alley keeps the afternoon practical. Hotel ↗

ICONSIAM

Allow roughly 20–40 minutes from the hotel depending on traffic. Explore SookSiam, shops and the riverside. Aim to leave at 16:15; 16:30 is the latest planning departure only if the live journey estimate still protects SkyWalk entry. Shorten shopping if delayed. No sightseeing river cruise.

Maps ↗

Transfer to Mahanakhon SkyWalk

Allow about 30–45 minutes including the route choice, then entry queues. Reserve the applicable sunset slot with a target of being upstairs by 17:00. Ticket price, final hours and slot conditions THB TBD / AED TBD; reconfirm before booking. Official tickets ↗

Maps ↗

Daylight, sunset, then the city lights

Sunset on 24 November is approximately 17:47. This gives daylight and golden hour before sunset, then time for early city lights. Weather or entry queues can affect access; leave ICONSIAM earlier if necessary. Sunset reference ↗

Song Wat Road

Allow roughly 20–40 minutes from Mahanakhon, then a short wander. Enjoy the streets and architecture; many cafés close earlier, so do not rely on a late café. Continue on foot toward Yaowarat.

Nai Ek Roll Noodles for peppery rolled noodles, T&K Seafood for grilled seafood, or Yaowarat stalls for grazing. Current food prices and opening hours THB TBD / AED TBD. The hotel is convenient for a roughly 15–25 minute walk or short taxi after dinner. Nai Ek ↗ · T&K ↗

09:00–11:00

The Grand Palace

Official visitor information: 08:30–16:30, ticket sales until 15:30; admission THB 500 (AED ≈56) per person, published admission; reconfirm. Cover shoulders and knees; wear proper long trousers or a long skirt, avoid transparent/ripped clothing and sleeveless tops. Check ceremonial closures. Official hours ↗

Maps ↗

Cross the river to Wat Arun

Walk/taxi to the appropriate cross-river pier and allow a queue. Visit 11:30–12:30. Planning hours 08:00–18:00; estimated admission THB TBD / AED TBD per person, reconfirm. Ferry estimate THB TBD / AED TBD per person each way.

12:30 → 13:00

K. Panich mango sticky rice

Mango sticky rice allowance THB TBD / AED TBD per portion. Typical hours 07:00–18:00, Sunday closure commonly listed; Wednesday fits, but verify. MICHELIN listing ↗

Lunch in the Old Town

EmSphere & Phrom Phong

Tichuca Rooftop Bar

Best for drinks, views and photos; treat light food as optional, not a full dinner. Cocktails estimated THB TBD / AED TBD each; snack allowance THB TBD / AED TBD, current food menu TBD. Queue/weather may shorten the visit. Official entry rules ↗

DAY 8 · SUN 29 NOV 2026 · PHI PHI

A full day for turquoise water.

Private long-tail · Pileh Lagoon · unhurried snorkelling · a quiet island afternoon

Early morning · out before the busiest boats
06:30 breakfast · 07:00 target start

Private long-tail from Tonsai

Arrange an early breakfast and a licensed private long-tail where practical. Confirm the meeting point, weather, life jackets, snorkelling gear and a route with generous swimming/snorkelling time. The 07:00 start is a request, not a verified booked departure. Keep your room: there is no checkout or Phuket transfer today. Private boat price THB TBD / AED TBD per boat; any shared alternative and park fee TBD.

Maps ↗
Morning · roughly 07:00–12:00/13:00

Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon & snorkelling

Agree the route with the skipper: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave viewed from the boat, Monkey Beach if conditions permit, and suitable snorkelling locations. Make time in the water a main activity, with generous stops at Pileh and good snorkelling sites rather than a rushed photo circuit. Tides, park rules, access and sea conditions determine the order and duration. Maya Bay swimming is not permitted; follow park instructions. Keep distance from wildlife. Confirm exact tour length and all inclusions before payment. Maya Bay ↗ · Pileh Lagoon ↗ · Viking Cave ↗ · Monkey Beach ↗

Do this in order

Book these first.

Book these first

  1. International flights: overnight 21 Nov departure from Sharjah, and 2 Dec HKT 18:20 target. Confirm baggage and exact dates.
  2. Thai Sky Adventures: 23 Nov 07:00 pickup, weather policy, requirements and onward Naklua transport.
  3. DMK→KBV: 26 Nov direct late-morning/noon target. Select this before deciding on arrival-day kayaking.
  4. Hotels: Pattaya 22–24 Nov; The Quarter Hualamphong 24–26 Nov, preferred Deluxe King City View; Ao Nang 26–28 Nov; Phi Phi 28–30 Nov; Phuket 30 Nov–2 Dec. Panwaburi is an option, not booked.
  5. SkyWalk: 24 Nov sunset slot; shorten ICONSIAM if needed to be upstairs by 17:00.
  6. Railay climbing: 27 Nov morning, boat/gear inclusions confirmed.
  7. Sea crossings and Phi Phi tour: 28/30 Nov crossings; private long-tail and dedicated snorkelling time on 29 Nov.

Can book later

  • Sanctuary: confirm guide language and afternoon slot once skydive timing is clear; check cancellation terms.
  • Klong Root: only after the flight and a named operator’s closing/last-launch time are confirmed.
  • Massage and restaurants: reserve convenient sessions/tables; final-day spa near the hotel only.
  • Local taxis: short rides can stay flexible; airport and intercity cars should be prebooked.
  • Karting: verify the requested activity type and operator; keep the track fallback clearly separate.
  • Big Buddha: recheck access and weather closer to the visit.

A week before travel: recheck all hours, admissions and baggage. Before every boat: confirm pier, check-in, luggage limits, weather and the return plan. Dates stay fixed; local timing remains flexible.
